name: Coriander
siboNotes: Fresh coriander is well-tolerated and can help add flavor without triggering SIBO symptoms. Use freely as a low-FODMAP herb option.
preparationTips: Wash thoroughly and pat dry before chopping to prevent wilting
Add fresh leaves at the end of cooking to preserve bright flavor
Store stems up in water like flowers to maintain freshness
Freeze chopped coriander in ice cube trays with oil for easy portioning
